project_type: React 18.3 + TypeScript + Vite frontend, Arabic RTL EdTech platform
build_system: Vite 5.4 with tsc type-checking, no Tailwind, custom CSS design system
test_framework: No test framework configured in frontend. Validation is via tsc typecheck + vite build
build_command: cd /projects/sandbox/madarek/frontend && npx tsc -b --noEmit && npx vite build
verification_instructions: 1. Run tsc --noEmit to verify TypeScript compiles. 2. Run vite build to verify the bundle compiles without errors. 3. Verify CSS brace-balance across all modified files.
setup_instructions: All dependencies pre-installed in node_modules. No npm install needed. INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - cannot install new packages, cannot pull images. All dependencies (react 18.3, lucide-react, chart.js, react-router-dom, zustand, react-hook-form, tanstack-query) already in node_modules. Must use pre-installed runtimes only. Validation is AST/build-based only.
contribution_requirements: Preserve RTL support (use logical properties: inset-inline-start/end, margin-inline, padding-inline, etc). Preserve all routing and functionality. Preserve academic/university identity. Use Lucide icons consistently. Include prefers-reduced-motion fallbacks for all animations.
key_patterns: CSS design tokens in tokens.css (8px grid, Material 3 color system). Component-level overrides in stitch-canonical.css. Page-specific CSS: landing.css, dashboard.css, premium.css, polish.css. useReveal hook for scroll-triggered animations. Card/Badge/Icon primitives in components/primitives. AppShell layout: Sidebar + Topbar + content area + BottomNav. Dark/light theme via data-theme attribute.
directory_structure: frontend/src/styles/ - 17 CSS files forming the design system. frontend/src/pages/ - LandingPage, AuthPage, DocumentViewerPage + directories for student (19 pages), teacher, admin, quality, owner, vision, exams, community. frontend/src/components/ - BrandMark, Icon, EmojiIcon + layout (AppShell, Sidebar, Topbar, BottomNav, ThemeToggle, GlobalSearch, NotificationDropdown) + primitives + pdf + owner.
